Cashball is an innovative fill that leverages the unique properties of cashmere in an eco- and animal-friendly way. Made primarily of pre-consumer waste, it’s cruelty-free (since cashmere is humanely harvested, unlike some live-plucked waterfowl downs), environmentally friendly (since it makes use of the excess left behind in the cashmere refining process), and offers the lightweight, compressible, breathable warmth cashmere is famous for. It’s effective even when wet, draws moisture away from the body, and keeps its shape.

The Crew Neck Built for Layering
The Ledbury Black Crew Neck Undershirt is a versatile foundation piece designed for every type of layering — and it's the ideal choice for dress shirts you plan to wear fully buttoned with a tie. Black is the go-to for darker dress shirts, navy and charcoal suits, and any situation where a white or grey undershirt would show through. Clean enough to wear on its own, discreet enough to layer under anything.
A Fabric That Works as Hard as You Do
Crafted from a 47% Cotton, 47% Modal, and 6% Spandex jersey knit, this undershirt delivers exceptional softness from the first wear. Modal adds a silky smoothness and natural breathability that pure cotton can't match, while the spandex content provides just enough stretch to move with you — whether you're at your desk, in a meeting, or traveling between both.
